items.title: 2.8 Electronic configuration aur periodic table (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.8, printed page 38.

blocks.text: Anasir ki electronic configurations periodic table mein un ki jagah se juri hain, jo is tarah bana hai ke bairooni shell (valence) electron configuration ke ek jaise pattern wale anasir ek hi groups mein aate hain. Is liye unsur ki configuration table mein us ki jagah se likhi ja sakti hai, aur anasir ko us orbital ki qism se giroh-band kiya ja sakta hai jis mein un ke electrons rakhe jate hain.

blocks.alt: Block ke rang mein mukammal periodic table, har element ki alamat aur atomic number, aur har group ke oopar us ki bahari configuration: groups 1 aur 2 ke liye ns1 aur ns2, groups 3 se 12 ke liye d1s2 se d10s2, groups 13 se 18 ke liye s2p1 se s2p6. Notes f block ki shakal (n-2)f1-14 ns2 aur istisna Cr, Mo (d5 s1) aur Cu, Ag, Au (d10 s1) batate hain.
blocks.caption: Periodic table ke har group ki valence-shell configuration (Figure 2.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Baen taraf do columns hain, groups 1 aur 2 ke alkali metals aur alkaline earth metals, jin mein bairooni shell ke s orbitals bhar rahe hain; group 1 aur 2 ke anasir ki bairooni configurations bil-tarteeb ns1 aur ns2 hain. Group 13 par chhalang lagayein to configuration ns2 np1 hai.
Daen taraf chhe columns ka block hai jis mein sab se bairooni p orbitals bhar rahe hain.
Darmiyan mein das columns ka block hai jis mein transition metals hain, jin mein d orbitals bhar rahe hain.
Markazi table ke neeche chaudah columns ki do qatarein hain, f block anasir, jin mein f orbitals bhar rahe hain.

blocks.text: Adad 2, 6, 10 aur 14 bilkul woh electrons ki tadaad hain jo s, p, d aur f subshells bhar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Periodic table se cadmium (Z = 48) aur lanthanum (Z = 57) ki configuration noble gas core aur us ke aage ke electrons ke taur par likhein, aur antimony (Z = 51) ki poori configuration ghair-jure electrons ki tadaad ke saath.
blocks.explanation: Cadmium period 5 ke d block ka aakhir hai: [Kr] 4d10 5s2. Lanthanum 6s jore ke baad lanthanides shuru karta hai: [Xe] 5d1 6s2 (pehli f block jagah). Antimony, period 5 ka group 15, 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p6 3d10 4s2 4p6 4d10 5s2 5p3 hai; us ke teen 5p electrons ghair-jure hain, to teen.

items: Table mein jagah configuration deti hai: groups 1 aur 2 ns bharte hain (ns1, ns2), groups 13 se 18 np (ns2 np1 se), darmiyani das columns d, neeche chaudah columns f; 2, 6, 10 aur 14 subshell gunjaishein hain.
